title: Parity Matrix
description: Source-to-target parity status. Source and target labels are generic strings; the domain profile supplies real names at runtime. Domain-neutral: no source or target technology is named in this schema.

$schema.description: Scheme-less relative path from the instance file to its schema file.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. Major component pinned to the v1 directory; minor and patch are free.

source_label.description: Generic label for the source side. Real names are supplied at runtime, never encoded here.

target_label.description: Generic label for the target side. Real names are supplied at runtime, never encoded here.

parity_status.description: Parity state of the referenced feature.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence Reference id values grounding this row.

decision_refs.description: Product Decision Record id values relevant to this row.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about this row.

identifier.description: Shared identifier grammar. Lowercase alphanumeric start; dots, underscores, and hyphens permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp enforced by regex because the validator runs without a FormatChecker.

metadata.title: Free-form consumer metadata
metadata.description: Sanctioned extension point. Additional properties are permitted here only.
